title: Profit miss despite revenue beat
question: Operating profit missed budget even though revenue beat it. Quantify the key variances, state whether each is favourable or adverse, and explain the main driver of the miss.

gold_answer.summary: Operating profit was GBP 19k adverse to budget (-3.2%). Revenue was GBP 300k favourable (+6.0%), but cost of sales was GBP 339k adverse (+11.3%), cutting gross margin from a budgeted 40.0% to 37.0%. Operating costs were GBP 20k favourable, which only partly offset the margin shortfall.
gold_answer.main_driver: Cost of sales overran by more than the revenue beat, so gross margin came in 3.0 percentage points below budget.

design_note: Baseline. Tests favourable/adverse direction on cost lines, where a positive number is bad news. A response that calls the cost of sales variance favourable, or the operating cost underspend adverse, fails C3.
